title: Cowboy Casita | 12 min to Broadway | Parking!
description:
Located in Berry Hill, Cowboy Casita puts you close to everything in Nashville!

Just minutes from Broadway, 12 South, the Gulch, Green Hills, Nissan Stadium, the airport, and local universities, with Franklin and the Grand Ole Opry an easy drive away. 

Enjoy live music, shopping, dining, games, and all the fun of Music City, then come home to a quiet neighborhood with plenty of space to relax. 

Perfect for families, friends, events, or weekend getaways!

The space
The home features 3 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, a fully equipped kitchen, dining area, cozy living room, and additional sleeping space with a full-size futon and Twin XL floor mattress available when needed.

Step outside to enjoy the private back patio with an outdoor TV, seating, and gas grill, perfect for relaxing after a day exploring Nashville. Guests also have access to a washer and dryer, private driveway parking, and the entire home and outdoor space during their stay.

With plenty of room to spread out, gather together, and unwind, the home is a great fit for families, friend groups, wedding weekends, college visits, concerts, sporting events, and Nashville getaways.
